finishing_note: Springs: judged on evidence/table-view.jpg (1.63 m line of sight, 40 degree field, 16 px per degree) and evidence/spring-closeup.jpg (the same view at 3x). TRELLIS did not resolve the coils: they are lumpy relief, and at the far edge they read only as a pale strip along each arm segment, never as coils (a coil pitch of about 2 mm at lamp scale is under 1 px). Decision: no spring mesh and no extra triangles; the springs stay as the baked pale strip in the base colour and normal textures. UE can add a thin coil card or alpha-tested ribbon if a close-up needs it.
